desc: Implement the DSU + streaming-representative-per-multiple solution; verified on Example 1 (output 4) and Example 2 (output 2).
Validate edge cases: all nums > threshold (answer = n), value 1 present (unions via lcm(x,1)=x), threshold = 1, and n = 1.
Verify complexity/memory: O(threshold log threshold) union work with rep array of size threshold+1; values above threshold never indexed into DSU.
Split nums into large values (> threshold, each isolated) and small values (<= threshold) needing DSU processing.
Confirm correctness of unioning through shared multiples: a,b connected iff lcm(a,b) <= threshold, captured transitively by clique-per-multiple.
Chose streaming-rep approach to avoid list-of-lists bucket memory overhead.
